sqliteStartupGuard.evidence: A malformed existing SQLite file produced LOCAL_SQLITE_INTEGRITY_FAILED before schema setup; the original bytes remained unchanged and no WAL/SHM sidecars were created.

gracefulShutdownCheckpoint.evidence: The local-store test wrote a WAL-backed marker, closed through closeLocalDatabase, reopened read-only, passed quick_check and retained the latest row.

sealedBackupRestore.evidence: The existing Node SQLite backup and recovery suites passed with control data, encrypted credentials, conversation history, Codex-shaped native WAL/session state, workspace files, manifest hashes, symlink rejection, restore-to-new-directory and post-copy SQLite integrity verification.

zipReaderReplacement.evidence: Production ZIP paths use bounded memory-only reads, inflate only selected members, reject traversal and duplicate paths, and expose no filesystem extraction API. npm audit --omit=dev reported zero known vulnerabilities.

commands: npx vitest run server/utils/readOnlyZip.test.ts server/utils/configArchiveSecurity.test.ts server/utils/uploadSecurity.test.ts server/utils/officeArtifactPreview.test.ts server/localStore.test.ts scripts/create-release.test.ts scripts/mybay-ops.test.ts scripts/mybay-ops.recovery.test.ts --no-file-parallelism

fullSourceGate.evidence: npm run check passed Runtime and documentation validation, ESLint, three TypeScript boundaries, 375 Vitest files plus 12 native Codex bridge tests, copy/i18n/API-contract guards, and the production build.

liveControlDatabase.evidence: npm run doctor against the active v0.1.29-preview.1 SQLite path reported integrity ok and schema 8. Secret configuration checks were unavailable in the host shell and are not counted here.

liveServiceContinuity.evidence: The existing controller returned healthy v0.1.29-preview.1 and both the controller and target Codex Runtime retained restart count 0 during P0.4.

notRun: A stopped-writer whole-workspace backup and production cutover
Lossless recovery of an in-flight tool execution
boundary: This evidence hardens and validates shared control-plane data handling and ZIP processing. It does not certify Codex backup-restore, upgrade, rollback or security at the Certified level, and it does not raise the declared or verified Codex certification level.
